Latent Reasoning with Normalizing Flows (NF-CoT)
edges.note: Where R1 improves reasoning via RL over full token output, NF-CoT moves reasoning into continuous latent space with normalizing flows.

edges.target_label: Latent Reasoning with Normalizing Flows (NF-CoT)
edges.note: NF-CoT directly addresses open problems catalogued in the latent reasoning survey.

edges.target_label: Latent Reasoning with Normalizing Flows (NF-CoT)
edges.note: Replaces GRPO reward-based approximation with normalizing-flow exact log-likelihoods in latent reasoning space.

edges.target_label: PauseRec: Implicit Reasoning for LLM-based Generative Recommendation (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought writes the reasoning out as text, PauseRec keeps the extra computation but drops the text through inserted pause steps.

edges.target_label: PauseRec: Implicit Reasoning for LLM-based Generative Recommendation (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 trains long explicit reasoning traces, PauseRec reaches most of the benefit at lower training cost with implicit pauses.

edges.target_label: RLVR Implicitly Incentivizes Correct Reasoning in Base LLMs (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 measured success by the final answer under verifiable-reward RL, this paper introduces CoT-Pass@K to score the correctness of the intermediate steps directly.

edges.target_label: RLVR Implicitly Incentivizes Correct Reasoning in Base LLMs (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought treated the reasoning trace as a prompting device, this paper treats trace correctness as the quantity the reward implicitly shapes.

edges.target_label: Agentic Reasoning for Large Language Models (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought keeps reasoning inside one text trace, this paper moves to an act-observe-reason loop so a wrong step can be corrected by evidence.

edges.target_label: Agentic Reasoning for Large Language Models (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 trained long single-pass reasoning traces, this paper frames reasoning as an agentic control loop rather than one output.

edges.target_label: Agentic Reasoning for Large Language Models (2026)
edges.note: Where ToolkenGPT added tool calls as a capability, this paper makes the tool call part of a reasoning policy.

edges.target_label: Tandem Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 optimized a single model for correctness and let the reasoning style drift, Tandem RL adds a frozen weak junior to the rollout and rewards the pair so the trace stays legible.

edges.target_label: Tandem Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought asked for legible steps through prompting, Tandem RL makes legibility an emergent property of the training structure rather than a prompt instruction.

edges.target_label: MentalThink: Shaping Thoughts in Mental SVG World (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought externalizes reasoning as text tokens, MentalThink externalizes each step as executable SVG that is rendered and inspected before revision.

edges.target_label: MentalThink: Shaping Thoughts in Mental SVG World (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 rewards correct final answers, MentalThink keeps the reinforcement-learning outer loop but rewards useful inspection and revision of a rendered drawing.

edges.target_label: MentalThink: Shaping Thoughts in Mental SVG World (2026)
edges.note: Where the survey mapped the space of multimodal reasoning methods, MentalThink adds an executable-sketch reasoning mode with a checkable intermediate representation.

edges.target_label: TREK: Distill to Explore, Reinforce to Refine (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 rewards trajectories the model already samples, TREK first imports verified off-support solutions through a short distillation phase, then reinforces.

edges.target_label: TREK: Distill to Explore, Reinforce to Refine (2026)
edges.note: TREK targets the exploration stall the Group Relative Policy Optimization family shares by warming up on verified off-support solutions before on-policy reinforcement.

edges.target_label: Understanding Reasoning from Pretraining to Post-Training (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought draws reasoning out of a frozen pretrained model by prompting, this paper measures how the pretraining stage sets the ceiling and speed of the later RL stage, separating the contribution of pretraining from that of RL.

edges.target_label: Understanding Reasoning from Pretraining to Post-Training (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 trains reasoning through RL with verifiable rewards, this paper shows post-RL reward is predicted by pretraining loss and that RL surfaces correct moves nearly absent before rather than only sharpening the fine-tuned policy.

edges.target_label: Group Entropy-Controlled Policy Optimization (GEPO) (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 applied one reward-normalization scheme uniformly across all prompts, GEPO conditions the advantage shaping on each group's estimated entropy so easy low-entropy and hard high-entropy prompts get different exploration pressure.

edges.target_label: Group Entropy-Controlled Policy Optimization (GEPO) (2026)
edges.note: DeepSeek-V3 is the base-model lineage behind the R1 reasoning recipe; GEPO modifies the GRPO advantage normalization that recipe standardized.

edges.target_label: Stale but Stable: Staleness-Adaptive Trust Regions for Asynchronous RL (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 assumed near on-policy rollouts, this paper stabilizes verifiable-reward reinforcement learning when rollouts are stale because generation and training are decoupled for speed.

edges.target_label: Stale but Stable: Staleness-Adaptive Trust Regions for Asynchronous RL (2026)
edges.note: Where PPO clips a fixed symmetric ratio band on every token, SAT keeps that band on ordinary tokens and contracts only the outward endpoint on tokens flagged as stale, so the constraint follows the actual mismatch.

edges.target_label: Stale but Stable: Staleness-Adaptive Trust Regions for Asynchronous RL (2026)
edges.note: Where Latent-GRPO and the GSPO family treat the group as uniformly trustworthy, SAT weights the update by per-token staleness within the group.
